functions.name: appendParticleRecord
functions.notes: Appends a 40-byte record, folds four source floats through swap loops, then updates record fields, a six-float accumulator and two source values.

functions.name: appendParticleRecordVariant
functions.notes: Same record layout as 683 with thresholds 10/0, a 0/10 word pair at +48, and accumulator/source fields 4/12 instead of 0/8.

validation.comparison: Every case checks the return value, all 67,108,864 memory bytes and the stack pointer. 683 covers 20 finite pairs, five counts, special floats and 64 random rows; 1105 covers 20 finite pairs, special floats, four counts and 64 random rows.
limitations: The caller owns the count pointer, record array, source struct and accumulator addresses.
The swap loops intentionally exit in swapped order for NaN pairs.
Accumulator updates use compare-and-select, so a NaN candidate keeps the old value.
Source updates use f32.max and therefore propagate NaN.
1105 uses thresholds 10/0 and stores 0/10 at +48/+52. Ledger: 349 client bodies recovered and 3,896 remain machine code.
